$comment: Exact pin of the finplan-contracts package consumed by FinanceLambdasTool (task 1.2, contracts CS-04 consumer case). The digest is the SHA-256 of the exact vendored wheel (also recorded in uv.lock, which uv verifies on install). The wheel is the FinancialPlanning-built artifact copied byte for byte; once the CodeArtifact registry (/finplan/shared/financialplanning/contract/registry-ref) serves it, the registry asset must carry this same digest. Re-pin: scripts/check_contracts_pin.py --repin. 0.x pins are beta-only.
source: FinancialPlanning vendored wheel (built reproducibly from its contracts/python; FinanceLambdasTool never holds the contract sources)
